title: DSX | Workload Overview
description: All published workloads, independent phase history and optional resource trends. One cluster per datasource and one exporter scrape job. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0; Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA Corporation.

options.content:
### Workload overview
All published workloads in the selected namespaces. Open a workload to inspect its components and Pods. Resource charts use the optional cAdvisor and DCGM jobs; gaps mean unavailable measurements.

Load both rules from `recording-rules.yaml`. For missing inventory or observations, check Collection below and Metric Samples.

panels.title: Summary | published identities and independent phases
Published identities
panels.description: Identities include retained-invalid and failure-only observations. Mapping count is accepted emitted attribution, not actual or desired Pods or discovery completeness. Zero is filled only against published workload identities.

targets.expr: sum(count by (job, namespace, workload_name, workload_uid) (dsx:pod_attribution:unique{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", observation_valid="true"}) or on (job, namespace, workload_name, workload_uid) (0 * dsx:workload:observed{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}))

panels.title: Independent phase matches
panels.description: Several phases can match one workload. Counts are independent; never sum them as a workload total. Invalid status, metadata conflicts and disagreeing values are excluded. No selected definition and all-zero phases differ from unavailable status.

panels.title: Workload phase history | each phase is independent
panels.description: One row per workload UID and phase. Colored intervals name the matching phase. Several phases may match together. Hover an interval for observed start and end times. Gaps mean status is unavailable, invalid or conflicting. Page through nine rows at a time.

panels.title: Maximum measured GPU utilization | current top 10
panels.description: Maximum measured device utilization, not allocated capacity or idleness. Requires DCGM namespace, nonempty pod_uid and UUID. Out-of-range samples and conflicting device streams are rejected. Open a workload for component and Pod attribution.

targets.expr: topk(10, (max by (namespace, workload_name, workload_uid) ((((max by (namespace, pod_uid, UUID, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod_uid!="", UUID!=""}) == min by (namespace, pod_uid, UUID, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod_uid!="", UUID!=""})) >= 0) and ((max by (namespace, pod_uid, UUID, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod_uid!="", UUID!=""}) == min by (namespace, pod_uid, UUID, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod_uid!="", UUID!=""})) <= 100)) * on (namespace, pod_uid) group_left (workload_name, workload_uid) (dsx:pod_attribution:unique{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", observation_valid="true"}))) and on () (min(up{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}"}) == 1) and on () (min(up{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: GPU framebuffer used | current top 10
panels.description: Framebuffer use reported by distinct matched GPU entities. Shared-device rows within a workload count once; conflicting readings are excluded. MiB are converted to bytes. This is device memory, not per-process allocation.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (namespace, workload_name, workload_uid) ((max by (namespace, workload_name, workload_uid, UUID, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) ((((max by (namespace, pod_uid, UUID, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod_uid!="", UUID!=""}) == min by (namespace, pod_uid, UUID, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod_uid!="", UUID!=""})) >= 0) * 1048576) * on (namespace, pod_uid) group_left (workload_name, workload_uid) (dsx:pod_attribution:unique{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", observation_valid="true"})) == min by (namespace, workload_name, workload_uid, UUID, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) ((((max by (namespace, pod_uid, UUID, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod_uid!="", UUID!=""}) == min by (namespace, pod_uid, UUID, gpu, GPU_I_ID, GPU_CI_ID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod_uid!="", UUID!=""})) >= 0) * 1048576) * on (namespace, pod_uid) group_left (workload_name, workload_uid) (dsx:pod_attribution:unique{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", observation_valid="true"}))))) and on () (min(up{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}"}) == 1) and on () (min(up{job=~"${dcgm_job:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: CPU and memory | optional cAdvisor source
CPU cores | current top 10
panels.description: Five-minute average CPU cores. One selected cAdvisor job; identical streams collapse and ambiguous container identities are rejected. Pod-name joins can cross name reuse and apply current attribution to the rate window. Open a workload for component and Pod attribution.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (namespace, workload_name, workload_uid) (label_replace(((max by (namespace, pod, container, id) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job=~"${cadvisor_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod!="", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) == min by (namespace, pod, container, id) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job=~"${cadvisor_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod!="", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])))) and on (namespace, pod, container) (count by (namespace, pod, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container, id) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job=~"${cadvisor_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod!="", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) == min by (namespace, pod, container, id) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job=~"${cadvisor_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pod!="", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])))) == 1), "pod_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)") * on (namespace, pod_name) group_left (workload_name, workload_uid) (dsx:pod_attribution:unique{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", observation_valid="true"}))) and on () (min(up{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}"}) == 1) and on () (min(up{job=~"${cadvisor_job:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: Collection | exporter targets and reported failures
Exporter targets
panels.description: Per-target scrape state and maximum age of currently queryable raw DSX samples. Missing targets and missing diagnostics are not zero or healthy. Sample age is not Kubernetes evaluation age.

targets.expr: label_replace(up{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}"}, "signal", "Scrape up", "", ".*") or label_replace(max by (job, instance) (time() - timestamp({__name__=~"dsx_workload_.*|dsx_exporter_observation_valid", job=~"${exporter_job:regex}"})), "signal", "Raw sample age (s)", "", ".*")

panels.title: Reported failures and retained-invalid observations
panels.description: Raw target rows retain failure scope, reason and invalid observations. No rows means no reported rows, not proven health. Metric Samples exposes all status values and metadata for replica disagreements.

targets.expr: dsx_exporter_observation_valid{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}|^$"} == 0 or dsx_workload_status{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", observation_valid="false"} or dsx_workload_pod_info{job=~"${exporter_job:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", observation_valid="false"}
